title: Integrate source-authorized Timeline corrections into Command Incident to Investigate Case navigation
goal: Complete the existing Command Incident -> linked Investigate Case HTTP route by using the source-identical, already-tested Investigate CAP-INV-110 correction projection from PR #194. Demonstrate a real linked Case response where the older Event is marked superseded even across a different paginated Case GET, without transferring Command permissions.
invariants: Preserve exact PR #194 blob identities for the Timeline projection, its complete source-negative regression, manifest and handoff; no modifications to frozen #194/#198 audit heads
Existing source-owner Case, Timeline Entry and typed source validation decides projected supersession; Command Incident authorization never confers Investigate Case.read
No new HTTP route, auth/session bridge, status source, persistence, mutation, audit or second timeline engine

A predecessor is marked superseded only if authorized successor with higher version exists in the full pre-pagination authorized snapshot; hidden/denied successor causes no field or metadata disclosure
Historical source-derived claim is scoped to visible authorized entries and not a global declaration that an inaccessible newer version does not exist
Independent Go 1.26.10 module dependencies and strict engineering checks remain unchanged; code is not production/deployed
security_properties: Command-only principal may follow the URL but receives generic 404 without correction/source content at Investigate handler
Denied Case, invalid principal, wrong tenant/environment and hidden successor cannot produce a superseded flag or ID leak
No permissions are accepted from the client or inferred from a navigation pointer; mutations OPEN-013 remain excluded

migration.rationale: Additive nullable read-only Timeline projection field, no data schema migration

rollback.strategy: Drop the borrowed source-identical Timeline projection/test and the combined-authority host fixture/test; retain existing Command+Investigate same-origin router and original sources
verification: Existing host read test remains successful
